item.title: Allie Ziebell ties program record to lead shorthanded UConn women’s basketball in rout of Xavier
item.description: Sophomore Allie Ziebell tied UConn's program record for single-game 3-pointers in a 97-39 rout of Xavier on Wednesday at Gampel Pavilion.
